description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget `GameKeyboard`, which renders an on-screen QWERTY keyboard with visual indicators based on tile states for a word-guessing game. It manages layout, styling, and user interaction for key presses including special keys like Enter and Backspace.

classes.name: GameKeyboard
classes.description: A stateless widget representing an on-screen QWERTY keyboard with color-coded keys based on game tile states.

methods.name: _bgFor
methods.description: Determines the background color of a key based on its TileState.

methods.name: _fgFor
methods.description: Determines the foreground (text) color of a key based on its TileState.

methods.name: _buildKey
methods.description: Builds a single key widget with styling and tap handling.

methods.name: _buildRow
methods.description: Creates a row of key widgets from a string of letters.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the entire keyboard widget layout with rows of keys.
